label: SarvNema approved Persian commercial narrator

pronunciation.meaning: sarv = cypress tree; no conjunction or extra vowel between sarv and nema

delivery.tone: Warm, lightly playful male Persian commercial narration; expressive but understandable
delivery.guidance: Use one continuous take. Vary pace by phrase, preserve punctuation and short sentence pauses; warm brand mention, then a short pause before the CTA. Do not add joke words or laughter, stitch sentence clips, remove internal pauses or uniformly speed up the recording.

limitations: New wording and provider updates can change a synthetic performance even with the same seed/settings. The preserved recording is the exact approved reference. No voice cloning or ChatGPT application voice setting is involved. Reference binaries stay local, outside Git.
